# American Heritage Dictionary

> A comprehensive online dictionary providing word definitions, etymological roots, usage guidance, and vocabulary learning resources backed by expert linguistic authority.

The American Heritage Dictionary offers authoritative English language reference materials including mobile apps for iOS and Android, expert usage panel guidance, and detailed linguistic appendices. The site serves as both a practical lookup tool and an educational resource for understanding word origins and proper usage.

## Key Topics

- American Heritage Dictionary
- Usage Panel
- Etymology
- Indo-European Roots
- Semitic Roots

## Getting Started

- [How To Use This Site](https://ahdictionary.com/word/howtouse.html): Guide to using American Heritage Dictionary site features and mobile apps

## Language Authority & Usage

- [The Usage Panel](https://ahdictionary.com/word/usagepanel.html): Reference on American Heritage Usage Panel authority and grammar guidance

## Vocabulary & Learning Resources

- [100 Words - American Heritage Dictionaries](https://ahdictionary.com/word/hundredwords.html): Vocabulary learning guide featuring 100 important words with definitions

## Linguistic Appendices & Etymology

- [Appendix I - Indo-European Roots](https://ahdictionary.com/word/indoeurop.html): Linguistic reference guide to Indo-European word roots and etymology
- [Appendix II - Semitic Roots](https://ahdictionary.com/word/semitic.html): Linguistic reference guide to Semitic roots and Hebrew word origins
